title: 17th Foundation Day Celebration of the Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission Ghaziabad
bodyHtml:
17th Foundation Day Celebration of the Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission Ghaziabad.

The 17th Foundation Day of the Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission was celebrated on 23rd January 2025. Ms. Punya Salila Srivastava, IAS, Secretary, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare grace the occasion as Chief Guest.
On this occasion Ms. Punya Salila Srivastava interacted with scientific staff of IPC and took a round of the IPC laboratory facilities including Advance Level Research Centre. Dr. Rajeev Singh Raghuvanshi, Secretary-cum-Scientific Director, IPC welcomed, Ms. Punya Salila Srivastava and other guests present in the Foundation Day celebrations. Shri. Rajiv Wadhawan Advisor (Cost), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare was also present on this occasion. Dr. Rajeev Singh gave a presentation by summarizing IPC activities in the field of pharmaceutical standardization and pharmacovigilance to promote quality and safety of medicinal products in the country. Key achievements made by the IPC were also presented. Thereafter, Ms. Punya Salila Srivastava congratulated all the staff of IPC. On this occasion of 17th Foundation Day, plantation was done by the Chief Guest, Ms. Punya Salila Srivastava in IPC garden.
